title: Roof Replacement in Portland, OR
summary: In August 2024, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Portland, OR. The crew tore off the old, worn shingles down to the wood deck, replaced plywood where the deck needed it, covered it in new synthetic underlayment, and installed new light gray architectural shingles.
scope: Tore off all layers of the old roof down to the wood deck
Replaced plywood decking where it was needed
Covered the deck in Safeguard 30 hybrid underlayment
Installed new architectural shingles with standard ridge cap
Put in 24 inch valley metal, new double-seal vent pipe flashings and new plastic attic vents

faqs.question: Did the deck need any repair on this Portland roof?
faqs.answer: Yes, some. Once the old shingles were off, the crew replaced plywood where the deck needed it before the new underlayment went down.
